* Bullet 1 (*pagoda architecture*) repeats the first bullet of *Quick Hits* and the description under *Flowers*.
* Bullet 2 (*pollinators & Lamiaceae relatives*) repeats the second and fourth bullets of *Quick Hits* and the *Wildlife Value* section.
